endorsements.name: Yadhu Krishna
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-23404
endorsements.description: This affects all versions of package sqlite-web. The SQL dashboard area allows sensitive actions to be performed without validating that the request originated from the application. This could enable an attacker to trick a user into performing these actions unknowingly through a Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attack.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.6)

endorsements.name: Yadhu Krishna
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-25850
endorsements.description: The package github.com/hoppscotch/proxyscotch before 1.0.0 are vulnerable to Server-side Request Forgery (SSRF) when interceptor mode is set to proxy. It occurs when an HTTP request is made by a backend server to an untrusted URL submitted by a user. It leads to a leakage of sensitive information from the server.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)
